title: How Trump Got Israel and Hamas to a Truce

sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中度过七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星之外是什么。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗韦。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Thursday, a potentially historic agreement between Israel and Hamas began to take shape.
sentences.zh: 周四，以色列和哈马斯之间一项可能具有历史意义的协议开始成形。

sentences.en: The deal, brokered by President Trump, secures the exchange of all Israeli hostages for Palestinian prisoners.
sentences.zh: 这项由特朗普总统斡旋的协议，确保了所有以色列人质与巴勒斯坦囚犯的交换。

sentences.en: We ended the war in Gaza and really, on a much bigger basis, created peace.
sentences.zh: 我们结束了加沙的战争，而且从更大层面来看，真正缔造了和平。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be a lasting peace, hopefully an everlasting peace.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是持久的和平，希望是永恒的和平。

sentences.en: Leaders on both sides, and Trump himself, signaled that this was a decisive step toward the end of the two-year war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 双方领导人以及特朗普本人都释放信号，表明这是结束长达两年的加沙战争的决定性一步。

sentences.en: And Israelis and Palestinians broke out in celebration.
sentences.zh: 以色列人和巴勒斯坦人爆发了庆祝活动。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Mark Mazzetti on the remarkable deal-making that got us to this point and whether it really will bring peace.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事马克·马泽蒂将讲述促成这一局面的非凡交易过程，以及它是否真的能带来和平。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月10日，星期五。

sentences.en: Mark, having optimism about the end of this war feels pretty perilous.
sentences.zh: 马克，对这场战争的结束抱有乐观态度感觉相当危险。

sentences.en: Like, it can feel dangerous to even allow yourself to feel hopeful because we've seen these two sides inch toward deals and then retreat.
sentences.zh: 就像，甚至允许自己产生希望都觉得很危险，因为我们已经看到这两方多次向协议迈进随后又退缩。

sentences.en: The January ceasefire fell apart, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，1月时的停火协议就破裂了。

sentences.en: So I want to start by asking, does this feel different to you, this moment?
sentences.zh: 所以我先想问，对你而言，此刻感觉有所不同吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实不同。

sentences.en: And there's a few reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 原因有几个。

sentences.en: First of all, President Trump has said he's going to go to Israel soon to make the sort of formal announcement of the deal.
sentences.zh: 首先，特朗普总统表示他很快将前往以色列，对该协议做出某种形式的正式宣布。

sentences.en: The Israeli cabinet voted on Thursday to approve the deal.
sentences.zh: 以色列内阁周四投票批准了这项协议。

sentences.en: So that's another good sign.
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一个好迹象。

sentences.en: And it appears that Hamas has agreed to some of the major points of the deal, enough that everyone is agreeing that this is the beginning of a process that will take some time.
sentences.zh: 并且看起来哈马斯已经同意了该协议的一些主要条款，程度足以让各方一致认为这是一个需要一些时间的进程的开始。

sentences.en: But some of the biggest issues have been navigated that everyone sees and end in sight.
sentences.zh: 但一些最大的问题已经得到妥善处理，每个人都看到了终点。

sentences.en: Okay, let's break down what's in this deal, as far as we know right now.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们梳理一下目前我们所知的这项协议的内容。

sentences.en: So first and foremost, there's the exchange of hostages and prisoners.
sentences.zh: 首先也是最重要的是人质和囚犯的交换。

sentences.en: This is, for the Israelis, certainly the biggest point.
sentences.zh: 对以色列人来说，这无疑是最重要的一点。

sentences.en: Getting the remaining hostages from October 7th, 2023, back to Israel.
sentences.zh: 让2023年10月7日以来的剩余人质回到以色列。

sentences.en: This would be in exchange for prisoners in Israeli custody.
sentences.zh: 这将用于交换以色列关押的囚犯。

sentences.en: And this is by far has been the biggest point of contention.
sentences.zh: 而这迄今为止一直是最大的争议点。

sentences.en: And there seems to be broad agreement on that point.
sentences.zh: 目前在这个问题上似乎达成了广泛共识。

sentences.en: The other significant aspect that has been agreed to is that Israeli forces are going to withdraw from parts of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 达成的另一个重要方面是以色列军队将从加沙地带的部分地区撤出。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to say they are still going to be occupying a large part of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 现在，必须说明的是，他们仍将占领加沙地带很大一部分。

sentences.en: But there's going to be an Israeli withdrawal to some extent.
sentences.zh: 但以色列将在一定程度上撤军。

sentences.en: And that's another very significant point in this deal.
sentences.zh: 这也是该协议中非常重要的一点。

sentences.en: I mean, just to linger on the hostage element of this alone, that in and of itself is so significant, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅就人质这一要素而言，这本身就意义重大，对吧？

sentences.en: This has been the number one desire for Israelis.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列人首要的愿望。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you go to Israel, it is the one sort of galvanizing element of this war that brings Israelis together.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当你去以色列时，这是这场战争中唯一能将以色列人凝聚在一起的要素。

sentences.en: This is, no matter what they think of the prime minister or the government or the conduct of the war, everyone agrees that, first and foremost, you need to get the hostages home.
sentences.zh: 无论他们对总理、政府或战争行为什么看法，每个人都认为，首要任务是让被扣人质回家。

sentences.en: But my understanding, right, is that some of the thorniest issues are still on the table.
sentences.zh: 但我的理解是，最棘手的一些问题依然摆在桌面上，对吧？

sentences.en: They haven't been worked out yet.
sentences.zh: 它们还没有完全解决。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, for instance, what exactly is the requirements for Hamas to lay down its weapons?
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，哈马斯放下武器的具体要求是什么？

sentences.en: What is the future of rebuilding Gaza?
sentences.zh: 重建加沙的未来是什么样的？

sentences.en: These are things that could ultimately unwind any deal.
sentences.zh: 这些最终可能会让任何协议瓦解。

sentences.en: But as we said, some of the big things have been worked out.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所说，一些重大问题已经得到了解决。

sentences.en: And it is pretty remarkable given where we were just a month ago.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们一个月前所处的境地，这确实非同寻常。

sentences.en: And it should be said that the president and his team deserve a great deal of credit for negotiating this over the last month.
sentences.zh: 并且必须指出，总统和他的团队在过去一个月的谈判中付出了巨大努力，理应获得高度赞誉。

sentences.en: OK, tell me the story of what has happened over the past month, how the president and his team kind of got us to this place.
sentences.zh: 好的，请讲讲过去一个月发生了什么，总统和他的团队是如何把我们带到这个地步的。

sentences.en: So all of this began in a way that is really surprising.
sentences.zh: 这一切的开始方式确实令人惊讶。

sentences.en: It begins on September 8th when Steve Witkoff, who is the Trump administration's Middle East envoy,
sentences.zh: 它始于9月8日，当时特朗普政府的中东特使史蒂夫·维特科夫，

sentences.en: and Jared Kushner, who is the president's son-in-law, are meeting with Ron Dermer, who is Benjamin Netanyahu's senior advisor.
sentences.zh: 以及总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳，正在与本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的高级顾问罗恩·德尔默会面。

sentences.en: And they spend hours during that day discussing basically elements of a plan that they're preparing to present to end the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 那一天他们花了几个小时，主要讨论他们准备提出以结束加沙战争的计划的各项内容。

sentences.en: Then on the next day, September 9th.
sentences.zh: 然后是在第二天，9月9日。

sentences.en: Cell phone video shows people running in the normally quiet and peaceful Qatari capital.
sentences.zh: 手机视频显示人们在平时安静祥和的卡塔尔首都奔跑。

sentences.en: A very large plume of smoke above Doha and paired with that an Israeli military statement.
sentences.zh: 多哈上空升起巨大的浓烟，并伴随着一份以色列军方声明。

sentences.en: It is the first time Israel has struck inside Qatar.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列首次对卡塔尔境内发动打击。

sentences.en: Israel launched an airstrike into a residential neighborhood in Doha, which is the capital of Qatar,
sentences.zh: 以色列对卡塔尔首都多哈的一个居民区发动了空袭，

sentences.en: where senior Hamas leaders have lived for a number of years and where the negotiating team was meeting.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯高级领导人多年来一直住在那里，谈判团队也一直在那里会面。

sentences.en: And it failed, first off.
sentences.zh: 首先，这次袭击失败了。

sentences.en: The strike didn't hit the people that the Israelis were trying to hit, the senior Hamas negotiators.
sentences.zh: 空袭并没有击中以色列人试图打击的目标——哈马斯高级谈判代表。

sentences.en: And even after a year where the Israelis have struck in Iran and struck in Lebanon and Yemen and Syria,
sentences.zh: 甚至在以色列过去一年里对伊朗、黎巴嫩、也门和叙利亚发动袭击之后，

sentences.en: this felt different because you were doing it in order to kill the people you were negotiating to end a war with.
sentences.zh: 这次感觉仍然不同，因为你是为了杀害那些你正与之谈判以结束战争的人而动手的。

sentences.en: And doing it in a place, Qatar, that has been the sort of middleman, broker, to try to end the war.
sentences.zh: 并且是在卡塔尔这样一个一直充当试图结束战争中间人和斡旋者的国家动手。

sentences.en: And it sounds like that pretty extraordinary attack is taken as a clear sign that Israel's plan is to keep attacking Hamas rather than sit down at the negotiating table.
sentences.zh: 听起来这次非同寻常的袭击被视为一个明确信号，表明以色列的计划是继续打击哈马斯，而不是坐在谈判桌前。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Trump administration learned about the attack.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府得知了这次袭击。

sentences.en: We're still sort of trying to get details about when, but it was happening when they learned that the Israelis were about to strike in Qatar.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在努力弄清楚具体时间，但当他们获悉以色列即将对卡塔尔发动袭击时，事情正在发生。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And Whitcoff calls the Qataris as a sort of warning, but it's too late.
sentences.zh: 维特科夫打电话给卡塔尔人算是发出警告，但为时已晚。

sentences.en: So the Americans are angry about this because, first of all, the Israelis did it without telling them.
sentences.zh: 所以美国人对此很愤怒，首先是因为以色列人没有告诉他们就动手了。

sentences.en: And also, the Qataris are central to this entire process of trying to end the war that has been going on for two years.
sentences.zh: 而且，卡塔尔人对于这场已经持续了两年的试图结束战争的整个进程至关重要。

sentences.en: And the Qataris are furious because they've been playing this role as intermediary, and they weren't expected to be bombed by the Israelis who are a party to the negotiation.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔人也怒火中烧，因为他们一直扮演着中间人的角色，却没料到会被作为谈判一方的以色列轰炸。

sentences.en: And they demand an apology, and they basically make the argument that, well, you know, nothing's going to happen now without us.
sentences.zh: 他们要求道歉，并且基本上提出了这样的论点：好吧，如果没有我们，现在什么也不会发生。

sentences.en: And I was actually in Israel on the day of the strike, and all these questions were getting asked after it happened.
sentences.zh: 我当时正好在以色列，就在袭击发生的当天，所有这些问题在事发后都被接连提出。

sentences.en: What would Hamas do?
sentences.zh: 哈马斯会怎么做？

sentences.en: What would be the fate of the hostages now that Israel had just tried to kill the Hamas negotiating team?
sentences.zh: 既然以色列刚刚试图暗杀哈马斯谈判团队，人质的命运会如何？

sentences.en: What would the United States do?
sentences.zh: 美国会怎么做？

sentences.en: Would the Trump administration put any new pressure on Netanyahu?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府会对内塔尼亚胡施加任何新的压力吗？

sentences.en: In some cases, it seemed like on that front, maybe nothing.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，在这方面似乎可能什么都不会做。

sentences.en: But actually, as it turned out, there was a lot more going on behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，结果证明，幕后还有更多事情在发生。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲吧。

sentences.en: Well, some in the White House actually saw the failed strike as an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，白宫的一些人实际上将这次失败的袭击视为一个机遇。

sentences.en: Netanyahu had taken the shot, and he missed.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡开了枪，却没有打中。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's perhaps, they thought, a moment that could be exploited to get Netanyahu to budge on some negotiating points that he had long opposed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们认为这或许是一个可以利用的时刻，迫使内塔尼亚胡在一些他长期反对的谈判点上做出让步。

sentences.en: At the same time, there was, even amid the fury and the anger among Arab governments about the strike in Doha,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，尽管阿拉伯各国政府对多哈袭击事件感到愤怒和激愤，

sentences.en: they also saw the opportunity that perhaps they could work with the White House to press Netanyahu on an end of the war.
sentences.zh: 他们也看到了机遇，认为或许可以与白宫合作，就结束战争向内塔尼亚胡施压。

sentences.en: So there was a confluence of interest here where the Arab governments and the Trump administration saw that this was a chance to apply pressure on Israel.
sentences.zh: 因此这里出现了一种利益交汇，阿拉伯政府和特朗普政府都认为这是一个对以色列施压的机会。

sentences.en: Explain this confluence of interests here.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这里的利益交汇。

sentences.en: Like, what countries are we talking about, and what are the various stakes they have in this?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们谈论的是哪些国家，它们在这其中各自有什么利益攸关？

sentences.en: So there's a number of Arab and, more broadly, Muslim countries that were part of this negotiating group.
sentences.zh: 有很多阿拉伯国家，更广泛地说，还有一些穆斯林国家参与了这个谈判小组。

sentences.en: But more specifically, there's three, Turkey, Qatar, and Egypt, that over the years have had a great deal of influence over Hamas.
sentences.zh: 但更具体地说，有三个国家——土耳其、卡塔尔和埃及，多年来对哈马斯有着巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: They have supported Hamas in different capacities over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，它们以不同的能力支持过哈马斯。

sentences.en: And they all saw, for their own reasons, an opportunity to pressure Hamas because they wanted an end of the war.
sentences.zh: 出于各自的原因，它们都看到了向哈马斯施压的机会，因为它们都希望结束战争。

sentences.en: The Turks would love to have greater cooperation, defense cooperation with the United States.
sentences.zh: 土耳其人非常希望与美国加强合作，进行国防合作。

sentences.en: They want arMs.
sentences.zh: 他们想要武器。

sentences.en: They want planes.
sentences.zh: 他们想要飞机。

sentences.en: They want a better relationship with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他们希望与特朗普政府建立更好的关系。

sentences.en: The Qataris also, while they have a strong defense relationship with the United States, they also would like to have good relations with Trump administration and President Trump.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔人也是如此，虽然他们与美国有着强有力的防务关系，但他们也希望与特朗普政府和特朗普总统保持良好关系。

sentences.en: Recall that the Qataris gave Trump a new Air Force One.
sentences.zh: 回想一下，卡塔尔人送给特朗普一架新的“空军一号”。

sentences.en: Yes, the famous plane.
sentences.zh: 是的，那架著名的飞机。

sentences.en: Yes, and the Egyptians, who are the closest to Gaza, fear even more displacement of Palestinian refugees to Egypt.
sentences.zh: 是的，而与加沙最近的埃及则担心巴勒斯坦难民进一步流离失所到埃及。

sentences.en: And they very much, for their own security, would love an end to the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 为了自身安全，他们非常渴望加沙战争能够结束。

sentences.en: So in each case, these countries have their own self-interested reasons to get this peace deal done, to push toward it.
sentences.zh: 所以在每种情况下，这些国家都有出于自身利益的理由来促成这项和平协议，推动其实现。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what they did was work out a peace plan.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做的是制定了一项和平计划。

sentences.en: And they brought it to New York to present to the Trump administration negotiating team right before the U.N.
sentences.zh: 他们把它带到纽约，在联合国大会召开前夕提交给特朗普政府的谈判团队。

sentences.en: General Assembly.
sentences.zh: 大会。

sentences.en: So just recently.
sentences.zh: 也就是不久前。

sentences.en: Yeah, just recently.
sentences.zh: 对，就在不久前。

sentences.en: It was September 20th when the prime minister of Qatar meets with Witkoff and Kushner to present this Arab plan.
sentences.zh: 那是9月20日，卡塔尔首相会见了维特科夫和库什纳，提交了这份阿拉伯计划。

sentences.en: First of all, saying they need assurances that Israel is not going to bomb Qatar again.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们表示需要得到保证，即以色列不会再次轰炸卡塔尔。

sentences.en: And also that this will be used as a sort of blueprint to push the Israelis towards ending the war.
sentences.zh: 并且这也将作为一种蓝图，用于推动以色列人走向结束战争。

sentences.en: And Trump seems very keen on the idea, this idea of a, quote, end-of-war plan, that this is going to be not just a ceasefire, but actually to end the war.
sentences.zh: 特朗普似乎对这个想法非常热衷，这个所谓的“终战计划”的概念，即这不仅是停火，而是真正结束战争。

sentences.en: So then, when everyone's in New York for the U.N.
sentences.zh: 因此，当大家都在纽约参加联合国大会时，

sentences.en: General Assembly, Trump and Witkoff meet with the representatives of the Arab and Muslim governments.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和维特科夫会见了阿拉伯和穆斯林政府的代表。

sentences.en: And basically, they agree to points of a peace plan.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们就和平计划的条款达成了共识。

sentences.en: And, of course, the real question then was, what is Netanyahu going to do?
sentences.zh: 当然，当时真正的疑问是，内塔尼亚胡会怎么做？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So at that point, the Americans and the Israelis are negotiating directly during these marathon sessions in New York.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个阶段，美国人和以色列人在纽约的这些马拉松式会议期间进行了直接谈判。

sentences.en: And this takes place over several days in New York hotel rooMs.
sentences.zh: 这在纽约的酒店房间里持续了好几天。

sentences.en: And during these sessions,
sentences.zh: 在这些会议期间，

sentences.en: Netanyahu repeatedly tries to massage language of some of the proposals that would reduce Israel's commitments and also to create loopholes that might make it appear that Hamas was violating the deal.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡反复试图修改某些提案的措辞，以减少以色列的承诺，并制造漏洞，使人看起来像是哈马斯在违反协议。

sentences.en: What ultimately emerges is a deal that is pretty favorable to Israel, so much that it created some anger on the Arab side that the Trump administration has given away too much.
sentences.zh: 最终浮出水面的是一份对以色列相当有利的协议，以至于在阿拉伯阵营中引起了一些愤怒，认为特朗普政府让步太多。

sentences.en: But some of that anger may have been softened by what happens at the next day when Netanyahu and Trump meet at the White House.
sentences.zh: 但第二天内塔尼亚胡和特朗普在白宫会面时发生的事情，可能平息了部分怒火。

sentences.en: And part of the deal is that Netanyahu has to call the Qatari prime minister and apologize for the September 9th strike.
sentences.zh: 协议的一部分是内塔尼亚胡必须致电卡塔尔首相，为9月9日的空袭道歉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That photo came out where Trump was, like, holding the phone as Netanyahu made the call.
sentences.zh: 当时流传着一张照片，特朗普好像拿着电话，而内塔尼亚胡在打电话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The White House put out the photo.
sentences.zh: 白宫发布了这张照片。

sentences.en: It was very clearly, intentionally made to look like Trump was putting Netanyahu in his place.
sentences.zh: 很明显、很刻意地让人觉得特朗普是在给内塔尼亚胡一个下马威。

sentences.en: By holding the phone, the cord is stretching all the way to Netanyahu's ear.
sentences.zh: 通过拿着电话，电话线一直延伸到内塔尼亚胡的耳朵。

sentences.en: Netanyahu doesn't look happy.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡看起来很不高兴。

sentences.en: Neither does Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普也是。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu is apologizing for this ill-conceived strike.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡正在为这次考虑不周的袭击道歉。

sentences.en: So after the phone call, Trump and Netanyahu come out and announce the deal.
sentences.zh: 所以在通完电话后，特朗普和内塔尼亚胡一同露面并宣布了协议。

sentences.en: And with typical Trump hyperbole, he calls it potentially one of the great days ever in civilization.
sentences.zh: 带着典型的特朗普式夸张，他称这可能是文明史上最伟大的日子之一。

sentences.en: He's really going for it.
sentences.zh: 他真的是势在必得。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, you know, Netanyahu is more measured, but everyone agrees that this is a major step.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，内塔尼亚胡更加谨慎，但大家都认为这是一大步。

sentences.en: And the next question is, would Hamas go for it?
sentences.zh: 接下来的问题是，哈马斯会接受吗？

sentences.en: And there are all sorts of reasons to think maybe they would.
sentences.zh: 而且有各种理由让人觉得他们可能会接受。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We covered this on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目里探讨过这个。

sentences.en: It seemed like a long shot initially, right, that Hamas would agree to this.
sentences.zh: 一开始觉得希望渺茫，对吧，觉得哈马斯会同意这一点。

sentences.en: They've been unmovable generally.
sentences.zh: 他们通常态度十分僵硬。

sentences.en: And as you said, the deal was seen to favor Israel.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这项协议被认为偏向以色列。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And there's some evidence that one of the reasons Netanyahu went along with this was because he was, you know, somewhat certain that Hamas wouldn't go along with it.
sentences.zh: 并且有证据表明，内塔尼亚胡之所以同意这一点，原因之一是他，你知道，有几分确信哈马斯不会同意。

sentences.en: And yet, at the end of last week, Hamas gave a signal that it was actually willing to come to the table.
sentences.zh: 然而，在上周末结束时，哈马斯释放了一个信号，表明它实际上愿意坐到谈判桌前。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Marc Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重新构想者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里打碟时，你每天上班都要带上 300 件你最珍视的宝贝。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把 DJ 台变成了一个像这样精美的、50 年前古董的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自阿彼陀的《重新构想者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连连看》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏旗下的智力拼图之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作《拼字蜂》和《字母连线》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏是由像你刚刚听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始游玩今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What is that sign that Hamas is actually willing to play ball?
sentences.zh: 哈马斯实际上愿意配合的迹象是什么？

sentences.en: So late Friday of last week, Hamas put out a statement that it was willing to discuss a hostage deal if certain conditions were met.
sentences.zh: 因此在上周五晚些时候，哈马斯发表了一份声明，称如果满足某些条件，它愿意讨论人质协议。

sentences.en: And as we said at the beginning, the hostages are the single biggest point of negotiation.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在开始时所说，人质是谈判中最大的核心议题。

sentences.en: So it was certainly a hopeful sign.
sentences.zh: 所以这无疑是一个充满希望的信号。

sentences.en: Everybody agrees to then meet this week in Sharm el-Sheikh in Egypt to negotiate whether, in fact, they can end the war.
sentences.zh: 各方一致同意本周在埃及沙姆沙伊赫会晤，就他们是否确实能结束战争进行谈判。

sentences.en: And at the beginning of the week, there was still plenty of skepticism that all the sides could come together.
sentences.zh: 而在本周初，各方能否聚到一起仍然存在大量质疑。

sentences.en: But as the week went on, it seemed as if things were coming together.
sentences.zh: 但随着本周的推移，事情似乎正在走向聚合。

sentences.en: Wednesday, Trump's at a public appearance on a totally different matter.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普在一场完全谈论其他事情的公开活动中亮相。

sentences.en: He's interrupted by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who hands him a note and whispers into his ear.
sentences.zh: 他被国务卿马可·鲁比奥打断，后者递给他一张便条并在他耳边低语。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was just given a note by the Secretary of State saying that we're very close to a deal in the Middle East and they're going to need me pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 是的，国务卿刚刚递给我一张便条，说我们在中东的协议已经非常接近达成，他们很快就需要我过去。

sentences.en: And Trump says, I'm going to have to leave soon.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，我得很快离开了。

sentences.en: You know, it looks like a deal is happening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看起来协议要成了。

sentences.en: Then President Trump posts on Truth Social that a deal has been reached.
sentences.zh: 随后总统特朗普在“真实社交”上发文称已经达成协议。

sentences.en: Mr. President, wow.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，哇。

sentences.en: If you would have asked me two years ago yesterday if this was possible, I would have bet everything I had no.
sentences.zh: 如果你在两年前的昨天问我这是否可能，我会压上我所有的一切赌不可能。

sentences.en: Congratulations, sir.
sentences.zh: 恭喜您，先生。

sentences.en: Can you give us more of the details?
sentences.zh: 能给我们透露更多细节吗？

sentences.en: And he goes then on Hannity.
sentences.zh: 然后他上了汉尼提的节目。

sentences.en: The whole world came together, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，整个世界都团结起来了。

sentences.en: So many countries that you wouldn't have even thought of it.
sentences.zh: 有那么多你甚至意想不到的国家。

sentences.en: They came together.
sentences.zh: 他们走到了一起。

sentences.en: The world has come together around this deal.
sentences.zh: 世界已经围绕这项协议团结起来了。

sentences.en: So that's where things stand now.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前的局势。

sentences.en: Trump has confirmed he's going to travel to Israel on Sunday and give a speech in front of the Knesset.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已证实他将于周日前往以色列，并在以色列议会前发表演讲。

sentences.en: And the reaction in Israel and Gaza has been one of joy and relief and a sense of optimism that hasn't existed for two years since the October 7th attacks.
sentences.zh: 以色列和加沙的反应充满了喜悦、释怀以及一种自 10 月 7 日袭击事件以来两年来未曾存在过的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: And so all optimism is cautious optimism.
sentences.zh: 所以所有的乐观都是谨慎的乐观。

sentences.en: But this does feel like it could be a turning point.
sentences.zh: 但这确实感觉可能是一个转折点。

sentences.en: There is a sense that the hostages could be coming back maybe as early as Sunday or early next week.
sentences.zh: 有一种感觉是人质可能最早在周日或下周初回来。

sentences.en: Mark, what you've described and what we're seeing unfold is genuinely an impressive feat by Trump.
sentences.zh: 马克，你所描述的以及我们所看到的进展，确实是特朗普的一项惊人壮举。

sentences.en: To be able to capitalize on what seemed like this giant setback, Israel literally bombed the negotiators and the mediators.
sentences.zh: 能够利用看似巨大的挫折——以色列公然轰炸了谈判代表和调解人——

sentences.en: To turn that around and get a deal that Biden couldn't get done, that no other leader in the world had managed despite trying for two years straight.
sentences.zh: 扭转局势，达成连拜登也无法达成、世界上没有任何其他领导人在连续尝试两年后设法取得的协议。

sentences.en: It is a significant achievement.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的成就。

sentences.en: He was able to bring the sides together that had shown no willingness to end the war.
sentences.zh: 他成功地让那些表现出毫无结束战争意愿的各方走到了一起。

sentences.en: And now they've come to this agreement.
sentences.zh: 现在他们达成了这项协议。

sentences.en: And it should also be said that one of the biggest things here is that he was willing to put pressure on Netanyahu in a way that President Biden was unwilling to do.
sentences.zh: 还应当指出，这里最重要的事情之一是，他愿意以总统拜登不愿采用的方式向内塔尼亚胡施压。

sentences.en: Why do you think that's the case?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么会这样？

sentences.en: I think there's a few reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为有几个原因。

sentences.en: First, I think Trump genuinely wanted to end the war.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为特朗普是真心想结束战争。

sentences.en: He campaigned on ending the war in Ukraine and in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时就承诺要结束乌克兰和加沙的战争。

sentences.en: He hasn't ended the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他还没能结束乌克兰战争。

sentences.en: And I think he was looking for a signature achievement.
sentences.zh: 我想他一直在寻找一项标志性的成就。

sentences.en: And a Nobel Peace Prize, famously.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，还有诺贝尔和平奖。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He certainly does want that.
sentences.zh: 他确实想要那个。

sentences.en: And he was also willing to put pressure on Netanyahu because, you know, their relationship has been fraught over the years.
sentences.zh: 而且他也愿意向内塔尼亚胡施压，因为，你知道，多年来他们的关系一直很紧张。

sentences.en: You know, Netanyahu famously in 2020 congratulated Joe Biden for winning the election.
sentences.zh: 你知道，内塔尼亚胡在 2020 年曾高调祝贺乔·拜登赢得大选。

sentences.en: And Trump's so mad about that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普为此非常生气。

sentences.en: And then coming to this year, when there were movements by Israel to go to war with Iran, Trump was trying to stop it at firSt.
sentences.zh: 然后到了今年，当以色列有对伊朗开战的动向时，特朗普起初试图阻止。

sentences.en: Remember, the Republican Party isn't the same as it used to be.
sentences.zh: 记住，共和党已经跟过去不一样了。

sentences.en: And, you know, support for Israel in the Republican Party isn't a given.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道，共和党内对以色列的支持并非理所当然。

sentences.en: There is a strain among Trump's base that thinks that America is too willing to support Israel in all of its endeavors.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的基本盘中存在一种情绪，认为美国过于愿意在以色列的所有行动中给予支持。

sentences.en: That he drags America into wars in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 认为他把美国拖入了中东战争。

sentences.en: And some of those prominent voices in the Republican Party, you know, Trump listens to.
sentences.zh: 而共和党内一些著名的声音，你知道，特朗普是听得进去的。

sentences.en: So it's not a given that an American president now, a Republican president, is going to necessarily reflexively back Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以现在一个美国总统、一个共和党总统，并不一定会下意识地无条件支持以色列。

sentences.en: And so that gave Trump leverage over Netanyahu because he was willing to push him.
sentences.zh: 这给了特朗普对内塔尼亚胡的施压筹码，因为他愿意向对方施压。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: Do you think there's a way in which only a Republican president could actually credibly convince Netanyahu that he could actually lose American support?
sentences.zh: 你认为是否存在这样一种可能：只有共和党总统才能真正让人信服地让内塔尼亚胡相信他真的会失去美国的支持？

sentences.en: Because if the Republicans stop supporting Israel, that's kind of it.
sentences.zh: 因为如果共和党停止支持以色列，那就真的完了。

sentences.en: The Democratic Party has really seen support erode for Israel.
sentences.zh: 民主党对以色列的支持确实在不断侵蚀。

sentences.en: So he's lost everybody if he loses them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他失去了他们，他就失去所有人了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've seen in the Democratic Party support for Israel splintering over the last two years,
sentences.zh: 我们看到在过去两年里，民主党对以色列的支持正在分裂，

sentences.en: certainly with the protests on campuses and Democratic politicians coming out against Israel's war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 当然伴随着校园抗议活动以及民主党政客公开反对以色列在加沙的战争。

sentences.en: You know, the Republican base on balance is more supportive of Israel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总的来说共和党的基本盘更支持以色列。

sentences.en: And yet there are these powerful strains in the Republican Party that are not.
sentences.zh: 然而共和党内部也存在着这些不买账的强大势力。

sentences.en: And nobody knows that more than Benjamin Netanyahu, who has built his entire political career in Israel on being the person who knows American politics the beSt.
sentences.zh: 没有人比本杰明·内塔尼亚胡更清楚这一点，他整个政治生涯都建立在自诩为最懂美国政治的人这一身份上。

sentences.en: And he knows that no matter what European support might erode, what he knows is that all that really matters is the United States.
sentences.zh: 他知道无论欧洲的支持如何侵蚀，他所知道的是真正重要的只有美国。

sentences.en: So he couldn't lose Trump in this.
sentences.zh: 所以在这件事上他不能失去特朗普。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Netanyahu is just keenly aware of how much he really needs American support.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡非常清楚自己有多么需要美国的支持。

sentences.en: He can't lose everyone.
sentences.zh: 他不能失去所有人。

sentences.en: He needs his most powerful friend.
sentences.zh: 他需要他最强大的朋友。

sentences.en: Yeah, he needs Trump.
sentences.zh: 是的，他需要特朗普。

sentences.en: And I think that was part of the calculus here for why Netanyahu went along with this.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是内塔尼亚胡顺从这一做法的考量因素之一。

sentences.en: And Trump was clearly willing to use that leverage.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普显然愿意利用这一筹码。

sentences.en: Do you think that's it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得就是这样吗？

sentences.en: Is that the story here?
sentences.zh: 这就是事情的全部吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有这方面的原因。

sentences.en: But then there's the other side of the negotiation as well, which is that the sort of key players in the Arab world in this,
sentences.zh: 但谈判还有另一个层面，那就是这其中的阿拉伯世界关键玩家，

sentences.en: the Egyptians and the Qataris and the Saudis and the Emiratis, they have a pretty good relationship with Trump.
sentences.zh: 埃及人、卡塔尔人、沙特人和阿联酋人，他们与特朗普有着相当不错关系。

sentences.en: And as we said earlier, they need the United States.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前所说，他们需要美国。

sentences.en: But also they kind of all speak the same language.
sentences.zh: 但同时他们也都算是在说同一种语言。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They're very transactional.
sentences.zh: 他们非常注重利益交换。

sentences.en: You know, they see Trump as a businessman and they do business deals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们把特朗普视为一个商人，并且他们做商业交易。

sentences.en: And Jared Kushner has done business deals with them.
sentences.zh: 贾里德·库什纳曾与他们做过商业交易。

sentences.en: So it's a language that certainly they didn't have with the Biden White House.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种他们在拜登白宫那里绝对没有的共同语言。

sentences.en: So for all the reasons that they saw the benefit of ending the war, they also had a relationship with the Trump White House that was, I think, conducive for this deal.
sentences.zh: 因此，出于他们看到结束战争的好处的所有原因，他们还与特朗普白宫保持着我认为有利于达成这项协议的关系。

sentences.en: Mark, do we think that in this deal, in this deal making, Trump outmaneuvered Netanyahu?
sentences.zh: 马克，我们是否认为在这项协议中，在这次交易中，特朗普智胜了内塔尼亚胡？

sentences.en: Like there have been several times over the last several months where it seemed as though Netanyahu was the one leading Trump around.
sentences.zh: 就像过去几个月里有几次看起来似乎是内塔尼亚胡在牵着特朗普走一样。

sentences.en: That was the impression that we got after the Iran bombing, for example.
sentences.zh: 比方说，我们在轰炸伊朗之后得出的就是这种印象。

sentences.en: Has that dynamic switched now or is it that the political realities for Netanyahu have just shifted so much that it made it easier for him to take this deal?
sentences.zh: 现在这种动态发生转变了，还是说内塔尼亚胡面临的政治现实已经发生了如此巨大的变化，以至于让他更容易接受这项协议？

sentences.en: I think it's impossible to answer who outmaneuvered who at this point, because there is plenty here that is good for Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 我认为目前不可能回答谁智胜了谁，因为这里有许多对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡有利的内容。

sentences.en: This is a political victory for him at a time when, you know, he's looking to run again for another term as prime minister.
sentences.zh: 在正值他寻求再次竞选总理连任之际，这是一场政治胜利。

sentences.en: And if he can announce that he ended the war and got the hostages home and didn't have to pull out of Gaza entirely.
sentences.zh: 如果他能宣布他结束了战争、让吉人回了家并且不必完全撤出加沙。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 那可是件大事。

sentences.en: It's huge.
sentences.zh: 这太大了。

sentences.en: So these two players talking about Trump and Netanyahu are savvy enough that they're going to get what each one wants.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个说到特朗普和内塔尼亚胡的玩家足够精明，他们会各自得到自己想要的东西。

sentences.en: And they both had to give up some, but certainly Netanyahu got a fair amount out of this.
sentences.zh: 他们双方都不得不做一些让步，但内塔尼亚胡确实从中捞到了相当多的好处。

sentences.en: So Netanyahu can credibly claim a pretty big victory in at least part of this.
sentences.zh: 因此，内塔尼亚胡至少在部分层面上可以冠冕堂皇地宣称取得了相当大的胜利。

sentences.en: What about Hamas?
sentences.zh: 那哈马斯呢？

sentences.en: Why did they decide to come to the table right now after all this time?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们在经历了这一切之后，现在决定回到谈判桌前？

sentences.en: Gazans have obviously suffered so much and Hamas hasn't budged before.
sentences.zh: 加沙人民显然遭受了巨大的苦难，而哈马斯之前一直没有松口。

sentences.en: So why now?
sentences.zh: 所以为什么是现在？

sentences.en: So we talked about the pressure that they were under from their benefactors, right?
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过他们金主施加给他们的压力，对吧？

sentences.en: The Qataris and the Turks.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔人和土耳其人。

sentences.en: But the big question here, of course, was why give up the only leverage really they have, which was the hostages, right?
sentences.zh: 但这里核心的问题当然是，为什么要放弃他们真正拥有的唯一筹码，也就是人质，对吧？

sentences.en: And what do they have once they give up the hostages?
sentences.zh: 一旦他们放弃了人质，他们还剩下什么？

sentences.en: And I think it's still a big question whether they see that this is living to fight another day, that there is still Hamas support in, for instance, the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 我认为这依然是一个巨大的问题：他们是否认为这是留得青山在，比如在约旦河西岸仍然存在对哈马斯的支持。

sentences.en: They might be unpopular in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 他们在加沙可能并不受欢迎，

sentences.en: but there is rising popularity for Hamas in the West Bank and that they still are carrying the mantle of Palestinian nationalism so that they can cut this deal and still be the champions of the Palestinian cause.
sentences.zh: 但在约旦河西岸，哈马斯的支持率在上升，他们依然扛着巴勒斯坦民族主义的大旗，这样他们达成这笔交易后依然可以成为巴勒斯坦事业的捍卫者。

sentences.en: But that all still remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 但这都还有待观察。

sentences.en: When we talk about Hamas living to fight another day, is what we're saying here that this group was really backed into a corner like they had no better option,
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论哈马斯留得青山在时，我们是在说这个组织真的被逼入了绝境，就像他们没有更好的选择一样吗？

sentences.en: that these fighters saw that this was really the end of the road for them?
sentences.zh: 这些武装人员看到这真的是他们的穷途末路了吗？

sentences.en: Well, if you think about what's happened in the last two years, right, almost all of the planners of the October 7th attacks are dead.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你想想过去两年里发生了什么，对吧，10 月 7 日袭击事件的策划者几乎全部阵亡。

sentences.en: Gaza is decimated.
sentences.zh: 加沙满目疮痍。

sentences.en: Hamas, at least the senior leadership of Hamas, is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯，至少是哈马斯的高层领导层已经被摧毁。

sentences.en: They have smaller and smaller parts of Gaza that they're in control of.
sentences.zh: 他们控制的加沙地盘越来越小。

sentences.en: So it is possible that they thought this was the best thing they could get and still preserve Hamas for the future.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们有可能认为这是他们能得到的最好结果，同时还能为未来保留哈马斯。

sentences.en: OK, so let's for a moment consider a situation in which everything does work out and the two sides reach a deal on the things that remain unsettled.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们不妨假设这样一种情况：一切顺利，双方就尚未解决的问题达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: The withdrawal parameters, the governance of Gaza post-war, whether Hamas will disarm.
sentences.zh: 撤军参数、战后加沙的治理、哈马斯是否会解除武装。

sentences.en: Let's say they resolve that.
sentences.zh: 假设他们解决了这些问题。

sentences.en: Should we think that would actually end the war?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该认为这真的能结束这场战争？

sentences.en: Do we think both sides would actually stick to the terms that they agreed to in that case?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们认为双方真的会遵守他们商定的条款吗？

sentences.en: The unfortunate fact is that the history suggests otherwise, right?
sentences.zh: 不幸的事实是，历史表明并非如此，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, Hamas and Israel have been at war with each other for decades.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，哈马斯和以色列已经交战了几十年。

sentences.en: And there have been occasional outbreaks of a hot war over the years that we've been in by far the worst one over the last two years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，零星的热战时有发生，而我们经历的过去两年无疑是其中最严重的一次。

sentences.en: But, you know, Hamas and Israel are avowed enemies.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，哈马斯和以色列是不共戴天的敌人。

sentences.en: And there's nothing in, certainly, the disposition of Hamas, which believes in the end of Israel, to suggest that they're necessarily going to change, ideologically,
sentences.zh: 而且，当然没有任何迹象表明，信奉消灭以色列的哈马斯会在意识形态上发生改变，

sentences.en: fundamentally change.
sentences.zh: 发生根本性的改变。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So there's plenty of, unfortunately, reasons to think that this isn't necessarily the end.
sentences.zh: 因此，不幸的是，有充分的理由认为这不一定就是终点。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, in this sort of grim history that we're outlining, there are moments when there is optimism.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道，在我们正在勾勒的这种严峻历史中，也有充满乐观的时刻。

sentences.en: And this may be one of them.
sentences.zh: 这或许就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to pause and acknowledge that in order to have a hope for the future of rebuilding, etc., you have to stop killing each other.
sentences.zh: 我认为停下来并认识到这一点很重要：为了对未来的重建等抱有希望，你们必须停止互相杀戮。

sentences.en: And hopefully that's where we are right now.
sentences.zh: 希望我们现在就处在这样的状态。

sentences.en: Mark, thanks for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 马克，谢谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Justice Department secured the indictment of New York Attorney General Letitia James on bank fraud and false statement charges after President Trump publicly demanded that she be charged.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统公开要求对纽约州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯提出指控后，司法部对其实施了关于银行欺诈和虚假陈述罪名的起诉。

sentences.en: James, a Democrat,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯是一名民主党人，

sentences.en: has been one of Trump's most high-profile opponents for years and brought a civil case against him for fraudulently inflating his assets in order to bolster the value of his net worth.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直是特朗普最引人注目的反对者之一，她曾对特朗普提起民事诉讼，指控他为了虚增净资产价值而欺诈性地夸大资产。

sentences.en: The investigation of James focused on two homes that she owned in Norfolk, Virginia, and in Brooklyn,
sentences.zh: 对詹姆斯的调查主要集中在她拥有的位于弗吉尼亚州诺福克和布鲁克林的两处房产上，

sentences.en: after a housing official suggested that she may have falsified records related to them.
sentences.zh: 此前一名住房官员暗示她可能伪造了与这些房产相关的记录。

sentences.en: These charges are baseless, and the president's own public statements make clear that his only goal is political retribution at any coSt.
sentences.zh: 这些指控毫无根据，总统自己的公开声明清楚地表明，他唯一的目的就是不惜一切代价进行政治报复。

sentences.en: And a federal judge in Illinois issued a temporary restraining order blocking the Trump administration's deployment of National Guard troops in the Chicago area.
sentences.zh: 伊利诺伊州的一名联邦法官发布了一项临时限制令，阻止特朗普政府在芝加哥地区部署国民警卫队部队。

sentences.en: The judge said she'd seen no credible evidence that there's a danger of a rebellion in the state of Illinois.
sentences.zh: 该法官表示，她没有看到任何可信证据表明伊利诺伊州存在发生叛乱的危险。

sentences.en: Her order is in effect for 14 days and is worded to prevent officials from sending in troops from another state.
sentences.zh: 她的禁令有效期为14天，措辞旨在阻止官员从其他州派遣军队。

sentences.en: It was not immediately clear what would happen with the troops already mobilized and deployed in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚已经动员并部署在伊利诺伊州的部队将会如何处理。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Ricky Nowetsky, Alex Stern, and Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由里基·诺维茨基、亚历克斯·斯特恩和斯特拉·陈制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Chris Haxel with help from Paige Cowett and Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·哈克塞尔剪辑，佩奇·科维特和丽莎·周提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Fact check by Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 事实核查由苏珊·李完成。

sentences.en: It contains music by Pat McCusker, Rowan Nemisto, Dan Powell, and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目包含帕特·麦卡斯克尔、罗温·内米斯托、丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为您准备假日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
